bullets.title: ACN: Massive beat-and-raise; AI bookings 3x, FY27 guide tops consensus
bullets.body: Accenture F4Q revenue $18.68B beat guidance ($17.75-18.4B range), with consulting organic growth accelerating to +2% vs -3.5% prior quarter. FY27 LC growth guided 3-6% (vs. Street 3.8%), operating margin 15.9-16.1% (+10-30bps), and $11-11.8B FCF. AI+data partnership bookings 3x YoY; stock +18.2% pre-market, lifting software peers (NOW, CRM, ADBE, TEAM, HUBS all +2-4%).

bullets.title: MU: Beat-and-raise; >75% of CY27 output committed, PT raises across Street
bullets.body: Micron reported inline-to-upside quarter with DC SSD revenue hitting ~$10B; Nov-Q guidance of $61.5B revenue and $38.15 EPS well above consensus. Management guided supply/demand tightening further in CY27-28, with 26 SCAs signed covering >35% of revenue through 2030+; newly signed SCAs priced higher than 1H. Raymond James raises PT to $1,500 (Outperform); DA Davidson raises to $2,100; JPM raises FY27 revenue/EPS estimates to $281.4B/$175.76. Company targets 100% excess cash return to shareholders from Dec 2026, with buyback well above prior $2.2B pace.

bullets.title: META: Muse hits 3M weekly users; re-rated to 21x NTM EPS, Top Pick at MS and Citi
bullets.body: Muse surpassed 3M weekly active users and 5M downloads in 22 days post-launch (faster adoption than ChatGPT, Grok, Claude). MS estimates META building/renting ~600M vCPUs in 2026, sufficient for 1B Muse DAUs at ~$37/user/month cost basis; monetization delayed to 2028 but stock re-rated from 14x to 21x NTM EPS with potential 27x on full adoption. META named customer for NVDA's Vera CPU with meaningful 2027 standalone revenue; MS and GS both flag as Top Pick in Internet.

bullets.title: GOOGL: Gemini 4 Argon launch removes key overhang; antitrust suits dismissed
bullets.body: Citi's Ron Josey reiterates Buy at $447 PT (20x '27 EPS), citing Argon's release as removing a key overhang and accelerating product cadence; model already used internally to optimize data center memory, freeing hundreds of terabytes without hardware purchases. Separately, US District Court dismissed all antitrust suits from Chegg and Penske Media, finding Google Search and AI Overviews are not separate products and rejecting reciprocal dealing, tying, and monopolization claims. GOOGL +1.7% pre-market.

bullets.title: CRWV: Forge platform launch reinforces AI cloud platform thesis; Citi reiterates Buy $159 PT
bullets.body: CoreWeave's Fully Connected 2026 event (5,800 attendees) unveiled the Forge platform for full AI model/agent lifecycle management. Demand expanding beyond frontier model developers into enterprises, financials, and quant trading firms; management reaffirmed 2H guidance and international expansion. Citi reiterates Buy/High Risk at $159 (~83% upside, 3.7x FY27E EV/revenue); Wolfe notes customer absorbing price increases with demand exceeding supply into 2027-28.

bullets.title: HOOD: Morgan Stanley upgrades to Overweight, $150 PT on durable platform deepening
bullets.body: MS upgrades Robinhood to Overweight with a $150 PT, citing broader platform capabilities deepening wallet share and engagement that support stronger, more durable growth. Hedgeye separately flags HOOD in coverage but no directional update; MS upgrade is the primary catalyst.

bullets.title: SHOP: Named primary agentic ecommerce beneficiary by Morgan Stanley
bullets.body: MS identifies Shopify as the primary beneficiary of agentic ecommerce via Agentic storefronts and transaction-based monetization, as part of a broader note on the MSXXCLAW agentic AI infrastructure basket (+22% since META Muse launch). The at-risk basket (MSXXARSK) is down 9% over the same period, with OTAs, cable/telco, and subscriptions most exposed.

bullets.title: NOW: JPM webinar Oct 8 on AI Control Tower momentum with elite-tier partner
bullets.body: JPMorgan hosting a webinar on October 8 at 11am ET with CoreX CEO to discuss ServiceNow AI adoption at scale, demand trends, and AI Control Tower gaining momentum for enterprise AI governance. No rating change, but event follows ACN earnings which showed AI adoption broadening—positive read-through for NOW.

bullets.title: MRVL: Investor Day expected to highlight XPU opportunity beyond custom silicon
bullets.body: DA Davidson expects MRVL Investor Day to highlight XPU attach opportunity beyond custom silicon, driving AI-driven revenue expansion. CRDO also flagged as having strong AI infrastructure demand with AECs underpinning growth; OmniConnect cited as >$1B revenue opportunity.

bullets.title: COHR/LITE: FCC optical transceiver restrictions likely at 3.2T gen; laser share key beneficiary
bullets.body: FCC Covered List expected to restrict Chinese-built transceivers at the 3.2T generation (~2028-29 ramp), with a 65%-US-content BOM workaround keeping module vendors viable near-term. LITE and COHR benefit from tighter laser pricing dynamics (50%+ gross margins vs. 30-40% for transceiver assembly); replacing Chinese capacity would require multi-year build given US capacity ~8x smaller than Chinese incumbents.

bullets.title: CEG: 20-yr 190MW nuclear PPA with Amazon; front-of-meter deals viable in PJM
bullets.body: Constellation signed a 20-year, 190MW nuclear PPA with Amazon at Calvert Cliffs, and separately acquired the Rhode Island State Energy Center from Shell for $715M. MS notes this deal demonstrates front-of-the-meter contracts can get done in PJM without 1-for-1 bring-your-own capacity; CEG +2.6% pre-market. PJM power prices up ~100% YTD.

bullets.title: BE: +34% in Sept on $6.4B Brookfield fuel-cell JV for data centers; joined S&P 500
bullets.body: Bloom Energy raised $6.4B with Brookfield for fuel-cell projects powering data centers and joined the S&P 500, with stock up 34% in September. BE is framing economics around 'rack cost of electricity' (RCOE) vs. traditional LCOE to capture full data center savings versus grid alternatives.

bullets.title: PSKY: PSKY-Warner merger approved, closing Oct 6; leverage >4x net debt/EBITDA a key risk
bullets.body: A US judge cleared the ~$110B PSKY-Warner combination to close October 6, creating an entertainment powerhouse with $6B in guided synergies (~11% of combined cost base). However, post-synergy net debt/EBITDA will exceed 4x at the highest borrowing-cost environment in a decade, risking delays to content spending and new product development.

bullets.title: TSLA: Remains active short at Hedgeye; auto-voting plan SEC-approved despite activist concern
bullets.body: Hedgeye maintains Tesla as a short position in its macro portfolio, down ~5-7.5% over the prior month alongside other consumer discretionary shorts. Separately, the SEC cleared Tesla's opt-in auto-voting plan allowing companies to align shareholder votes with management; activists warn this reduces shareholder influence.

bullets.title: ABNB/BKNG/EXPE: Agentic AI booking displacement risk flagged; ABNB holding up best in alt data
bullets.body: MS flags OTAs (EXPE, BKNG, ABNB) as facing booking displacement risk from agentic AI discovery, with the at-risk basket down 9% since META Muse launch. Hedgeye's alternative data shows ABNB mobile metrics holding up better than BKNG (mixed) and EXPE (weakest) heading into Q3 earnings; EXPE and BKNG face softer Q3 outlooks.

bullets.title: APP/CHTR: Near 52-week lows — APP -60%, CHTR -60% YTD
bullets.body: StreetAccount flags APP down 60.4% and CHTR down 59.9% from their 52-week highs, among 246 stocks at 52-week lows. GS September sentiment note also flags CHTR as oversold per 14-day RSI, alongside INTU and TTD.

bullets.title: MDB: Enterprise AI workload momentum; Cognition partnership targets FY28 ramp
bullets.body: Citi's Tyler Radke flags MDB's partnership with Cognition as deeper than appreciated, with commercialization scaling targeted for Feb 2027 and FY28 as the first meaningful revenue ramp. Migration opportunities accelerating in Financials (9-figure multi-year deal at T-1 bank) and Healthcare/Insurance; DA Davidson maintains Buy at $415 PT citing Atlas Agent Engine and legacy database migration momentum.

bullets.title: NVDA: GTC Berlin (10/20-22) and SEMICON West (10/13-15) as next key catalysts
bullets.body: GS September sentiment note cites NVDA GTC Berlin and SEMICON West as the next key catalysts for the stock, alongside Q3 earnings and cloud margins at hyperscalers. DA Davidson notes MU strength is a positive read-through for NVDA in the AI complex; Wolfe's MU management call confirms custom HBM work with NVDA (NVHBM) offering value beyond HBM 4E.

bullets.title: RCL/CCL: Cruise lines rally on yield beats; NCLH lagging
bullets.body: Carnival exceeded Q4 guidance with better-than-expected yield growth; Royal Caribbean outperforming peers significantly and GS sentiment notes cruise bookings as resilient. Hedgeye flags NCLH lagging materially behind peers despite a yield beat, maintaining a short bias on NCLH.

bullets.title: T/VZ: AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon form satellite JV to close coverage dead zones
bullets.body: AT&T, T-Mobile, and Verizon formed a joint venture using satellite direct-to-device technology to expand coverage in underserved US areas, with Paul Roth named interim CEO. JV complements existing terrestrial networks; existing carrier-satellite agreements remain in place. MS separately flags cable/telcos as structurally at risk from agentic AI helping customers switch providers and lower monthly bills.
